support_claim: Name overlap between NBA-102 ("Northbridge Analytics") and billing ("Northbridge Analytics Inc.") is noted in commercial notes, but the packet explicitly states legal has not determined the contracting registry entity and provides no shared legal identifier or explicit mapping to establish identity.

steps.fact: CRM record NBA-102 has the name "Northbridge Analytics".
Billing invoices list the billed name as "Northbridge Analytics Inc."

Commercial notes state that sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics" while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc.", but legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instructs treating the registry link as unresolved.
A 2024 credit check returned a separate Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC", adding a third unresolved registry candidate.
No packet observation supplies a shared legal identifier, explicit mapping, or uniqueness claim linking crm:NBA-102 to billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc.
